description: Attribution. Suppress only when attributor is not the speaker AND the risk-clause subject is not the speaker. Third-party concern reroutes, it does not vanish.

cases.text: the article said suicide rates are rising again
we covered suicide risk assessment in training today
my patient said he wants to die
my daughter told me she doesn't want to be here anymore
cases.note: family disclosure — the most common real hit in a family product

cases.text: my friend keeps saying he'd be better off gone and i'm scared
cases.note: third party plus help-seeking by the speaker

cases.text: i told my doctor i want to die
cases.note: attributor IS the speaker — a disclosure inside a reporting frame

cases.text: i wrote in my journal that i don't want to wake up
he said i should just die already
cases.note: reported abuse directed at speaker — not the speaker's ideation, but not nothing either
